cat <<'EOF' > app/models/account/data_transfer/manifest.rb
class Account::DataTransfer::Manifest
  attr_reader :account

  class << self
    def import(zip:, identity:)
      new.import(zip: zip, identity: identity)
    end
  end

  def initialize(account = nil)
    @account = account
  end

  def each_record_set
    raise ArgumentError, "No block given" unless block_given?

    record_sets.each do |record_set|
      yield record_set
    end
  end

  def export(zip:)
    each_record_set do |record_set|
      record_set.export(zip: zip)
    end
  end

  def import(zip:, identity:)
    validate_archive!(zip)

    id_map = Account::DataTransfer::IdMap.new
    new_account = nil

    ApplicationRecord.transaction do
      each_record_set do |record_set|
        record_set.import(zip: zip, id_map: id_map)
      end

      new_account = id_map.account
      raise Account::DataTransfer::Error, "Account could not be created from archive." unless new_account

      ensure_join_code(new_account)
      ensure_system_user(new_account)
      ensure_importing_user(new_account, identity)
      reindex_search(new_account)
      reconcile_storage(new_account)
    end

    new_account
  rescue Account::DataTransfer::Error => error
    cleanup_uploaded_blobs(id_map)
    raise error
  rescue ActiveStorage::IntegrityError
    cleanup_uploaded_blobs(id_map)
    raise Account::DataTransfer::Error, "An attached file failed integrity verification."
  rescue ActiveRecord::ActiveRecordError => error
    cleanup_uploaded_blobs(id_map)
    raise Account::DataTransfer::Error, "Could not import account data: #{error.message}"
  rescue StandardError => error
    cleanup_uploaded_blobs(id_map)
    raise Account::DataTransfer::Error, error.message
  end

  private
    def record_sets
      [
        Account::DataTransfer::AccountRecordSet.new(account),
        Account::DataTransfer::UserRecordSet.new(account),
        *record_sets_for(
          ::User::Settings,
          ::Tag,
          ::Board,
          ::Column
        ),
        Account::DataTransfer::EntropyRecordSet.new(account),
        Account::DataTransfer::BoardPublicationRecordSet.new(account),
        *record_sets_for(
          ::Webhook,
          ::Access,
          ::Card,
          ::Comment,
          ::Step,
          ::Assignment,
          ::Tagging,
          ::Closure,
          ::Card::Goldness,
          ::Card::NotNow,
          ::Card::ActivitySpike,
          ::Watch,
          ::Pin,
          ::Reaction,
          ::Mention
        ),
        Account::DataTransfer::FilterRecordSet.new(account),
        *record_sets_for(::Webhook::DelinquencyTracker),
        Account::DataTransfer::EventRecordSet.new(account),
        *record_sets_for(
          ::Notification,
          ::Notification::Bundle,
          ::Webhook::Delivery
        ),
        Account::DataTransfer::ActiveStorage::BlobRecordSet.new(account),
        record_set_for(::ActiveStorage::VariantRecord),
        Account::DataTransfer::ActiveStorage::AttachmentRecordSet.new(account),
        Account::DataTransfer::ActionText::RichTextRecordSet.new(account),
        Account::DataTransfer::ActiveStorage::FileRecordSet.new(account)
      ]
    end

    def record_sets_for(*models)
      models.map do |model|
        record_set_for(model)
      end
    end

    def record_set_for(model)
      Account::DataTransfer::RecordSet.new(account: account, model: model)
    end

    def validate_archive!(zip)
      if zip.glob("accounts/*.json").empty?
        raise Account::DataTransfer::Error, "The archive is missing account data."
      end

      if zip.glob("users/*.json").empty?
        raise Account::DataTransfer::Error, "The archive is missing user data."
      end
    end

    def ensure_join_code(new_account)
      new_account.create_join_code! unless new_account.join_code
    end

    def ensure_system_user(new_account)
      unless new_account.users.exists?(role: :system)
        new_account.users.create!(role: :system, name: "System")
      end
    end

    def ensure_importing_user(new_account, identity)
      return unless identity
      return if new_account.users.exists?(identity_id: identity.id)

      role = new_account.users.exists?(role: :owner) ? :admin : :owner
      name = identity.users.where.not(name: [ nil, "" ]).first&.name || identity.email_address.split("@").first
      new_account.users.create!(
        identity: identity,
        name: name,
        role: role,
        verified_at: Time.current
      )
    end

    def reindex_search(new_account)
      new_account.cards.published.includes(:rich_text_description).find_each(&:reindex)
      ::Comment.where(account: new_account).joins(:card).merge(::Card.published).includes(:rich_text_body, :card).find_each(&:reindex)
    end

    def reconcile_storage(new_account)
      Current.with_account(new_account) do
        new_account.reconcile_storage
        new_account.materialize_storage
        new_account.boards.find_each do |board|
          board.reconcile_storage
          board.materialize_storage
        end
      end
    end

    def cleanup_uploaded_blobs(id_map)
      return unless id_map

      id_map.uploaded_keys.each do |key|
        ::ActiveStorage::Blob.service.delete(key)
      rescue StandardError
        nil
      end
    end
end
EOF

cat <<'EOF' > app/models/user/data_export.rb
class User::DataExport < Export
  BATCH_SIZE = 200

  private
    def populate(zip)
      accessible_cards_scope.find_each(batch_size: BATCH_SIZE) do |card|
        add_card_to_zip(zip, card)
      end
    end

    def accessible_cards_scope
      user.accessible_cards.published
        .or(user.accessible_cards.where(creator: user))
        .includes(
          :board, :column, :tags, :steps, :closure, :not_now, :goldness,
          :image_attachment,
          creator: :identity,
          assignees: :identity,
          rich_text_description: { embeds_attachments: :blob }
        )
    end

    def add_card_to_zip(zip, card)
      comments = card.comments.chronologically.includes(
        creator: :identity,
        reactions: :reacter,
        rich_text_body: { embeds_attachments: :blob }
      ).to_a

      add_card_attachments_to_zip(zip, card, comments)
      zip.add_file("cards/#{card.number}.json", JSON.pretty_generate(serialize_card(card, comments)))
    end

    def add_card_attachments_to_zip(zip, card, comments)
      blobs = []
      blobs << card.image.blob if card.image.attached?
      blobs.concat(card.attachments.map(&:blob))
      comments.each { |comment| blobs.concat(comment.attachments.map(&:blob)) }

      blobs.uniq(&:id).each do |blob|
        path = blob_zip_path(blob)
        next if zip.exists?(path)

        zip.add_file(path, compress: false) do |sink|
          blob.download { |chunk| sink.write(chunk) }
        end
      end
    end

    def serialize_card(card, comments)
      {
        id: card.id,
        number: card.number,
        title: card.title,
        status: card.status,
        description: card.description.to_plain_text,
        description_html: card.description.to_s,
        due_on: card.due_on,
        closed: card.closed?,
        closed_at: card.closed_at&.utc,
        postponed: card.postponed?,
        postponed_at: card.postponed_at&.utc,
        golden: card.golden?,
        created_at: card.created_at.utc,
        updated_at: card.updated_at.utc,
        last_active_at: card.last_active_at.utc,
        board: { id: card.board.id, name: card.board.name },
        column: card.column && { id: card.column.id, name: card.column.name, color: card.column.color },
        creator: serialize_user(card.creator),
        assignees: card.assignees.map { |assignee| serialize_user(assignee) },
        tags: card.tags.map(&:title).sort,
        steps: card.steps.sort_by(&:created_at).map { |step| { id: step.id, content: step.content, completed: step.completed? } },
        image: card.image.attached? ? serialize_blob(card.image.blob) : nil,
        attachments: card.attachments.map { |attachment| serialize_blob(attachment.blob) },
        comments: comments.map { |comment| serialize_comment(comment) }
      }
    end

    def serialize_comment(comment)
      {
        id: comment.id,
        body: comment.body.to_plain_text,
        body_html: comment.body.to_s,
        created_at: comment.created_at.utc,
        updated_at: comment.updated_at.utc,
        creator: serialize_user(comment.creator),
        reactions: comment.reactions.map { |reaction| { content: reaction.content, reacter: serialize_user(reaction.reacter) } },
        attachments: comment.attachments.map { |attachment| serialize_blob(attachment.blob) }
      }
    end

    def serialize_user(person)
      {
        id: person.id,
        name: person.name,
        email_address: person.identity&.email_address
      }
    end

    def serialize_blob(blob)
      {
        id: blob.id,
        filename: blob.filename.to_s,
        content_type: blob.content_type,
        byte_size: blob.byte_size,
        path: blob_zip_path(blob)
      }
    end

    def blob_zip_path(blob)
      "files/#{blob.id}/#{blob.filename.sanitized}"
    end

    def notify_ready
      UserMailer.data_export_ready(self).deliver_later
    end

    def filename
      "#{user.name.parameterize.presence || "cards"}-cards-export-#{id}.zip"
    end
end
EOF

cat <<'EOF' > app/controllers/account/exports_controller.rb
class Account::ExportsController < ApplicationController
  before_action :ensure_admin
  before_action :set_export, only: :show

  def create
    export = Current.account.exports.create!(user: Current.user)
    export.build_later

    respond_to do |format|
      format.html { redirect_to account_settings_path, notice: "Exporting your account. You’ll receive an email with a download link when it’s ready." }
      format.json { head :accepted }
    end
  end

  def show
    if @export.expired?
      render "exports/expired", status: :gone, layout: "public"
    elsif @export.completed? && @export.file.attached?
      redirect_to rails_blob_path(@export.file, disposition: :attachment)
    else
      head :not_found
    end
  end

  private
    def set_export
      @export = Current.account.exports.find(params[:id])
    end
end
EOF

cat <<'EOF' > app/controllers/users/data_exports_controller.rb
class Users::DataExportsController < ApplicationController
  before_action :set_user
  before_action :ensure_current_user
  before_action :set_export, only: :show

  def create
    export = @user.data_exports.create!(account: Current.account)
    export.build_later

    respond_to do |format|
      format.html { redirect_to user_path(@user), notice: "Exporting your cards. You’ll receive an email with a download link when it’s ready." }
      format.json { head :accepted }
    end
  end

  def show
    if @export.expired?
      render "exports/expired", status: :gone, layout: "public"
    elsif @export.completed? && @export.file.attached?
      redirect_to rails_blob_path(@export.file, disposition: :attachment)
    else
      head :not_found
    end
  end

  private
    def set_user
      @user = Current.account.users.active.find(params[:user_id])
    end

    def ensure_current_user
      head :forbidden unless Current.user == @user
    end

    def set_export
      @export = @user.data_exports.find(params[:id])
    end
end
EOF

cat <<'EOF' > app/controllers/account/imports_controller.rb
class Account::ImportsController < ApplicationController
  skip_before_action :require_account

  layout "public"

  def new
    @import = Current.identity.account_imports.new
  end

  def create
    @import = Current.identity.account_imports.new(import_params)

    if @import.save
      @import.process_later
      redirect_to session_menu_path(script_name: nil), notice: "Importing your account. You’ll receive an email when it’s ready."
    else
      render :new, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  private
    def import_params
      if params.key?(:account_import)
        params.expect(account_import: [ :file ])
      elsif params.key?(:import)
        params.expect(import: [ :file ])
      else
        {}
      end
    end
end
EOF

This inconsistency is causing the problem where the links in the emails are `http://example.com/...`, while the links generated in the IntegrationTest use `www.example.com`. I need to either set a consistent `host` when constructing the URLs in the test by using `host: "example.com"` or use `account_export_path(...)` to work around this issue.

Okay, these are straightforward fixes. I'll get these test files updated, re-run the suite, and hopefully, these issues will be resolved.
